title: Inflation without an Inflaton III: non-Gaussian signatures
summary: We investigate primordial non-Gaussianity in the Inflation without an Inflaton (IWI) framework, where scalar perturbations are generated at second order by primordial gravitational waves in Einstein gravity on an exact de Sitter (dS) background. Since scalar modes are produced nonlinearly from tensor modes, non-Gaussianity is an intrinsic prediction of the mechanism. We compute the corresponding scalar bispectrum, derive the relevant contribution to the three-point function of the scalar potential, and evaluate its shape numerically.
